name: after-hide
rationale: Deliberately unmodeled: a third, Vue-only emit after the leave motion completes, with no Angular or React counterpart and no demonstrated consumer need (YAGNI); a future task can add it if a real need arises.

name: contentTemplate
rationale: Deliberately unmodeled: the content-composition point (ng content template, react render prop, vue scoped slot) used by Table has no PropFact/EventFact shape and is left unmodeled rather than force-fit into either.

name: sortOrderChange
rationale: Sibling output of the modeled sort-changed event (ng sortFieldChange), emitted from the same onSort() handler; the ng payload split across sibling outputs is recorded in sort-changed's payloadDescription instead of as a separate event.

name: multiSortMetaChange
rationale: Sibling output of the modeled sort-changed event (ng sortFieldChange), emitted from the same onSort() handler in multi-sort mode; recorded in sort-changed's payloadDescription instead of as a separate event.

name: rowsChange
rationale: Sibling output of the modeled page-changed event (ng firstChange), re-broadcasting .rows from the same onPaginatorPageChange() handler; recorded in page-changed's payloadDescription instead of as a separate event.

name: update:selection
rationale: v-model-only companion emitted with the identical payload alongside the modeled selection-change emit; it carries no independent semantic, so it is noted in the record header rather than double-counted as a fourth event.
